blocks.content: Remember Integer and Double, that we have used with collections. These are wrapper classes in Java.
Wrapper classes are used to convert the primitive data types (int, char, double, etc) into corresponding objects.
Here's a list of some primitive types along with their corresponding wrapper classes.
You might be wondering if there are primitive types, then why is it needed to have wrapper classes.
Since Java is an object-oriented language, sometimes we might need to use objects instead of primitive data types. For example, while working with collections
In this type of cases, wrapper classes help us to use primitive types as objects.
